description: Generality: the same execution credential charges another kernel-mediated resource. K executions in one Python process write files (async: K asyncio tasks interleaved on one thread; pool: two worker threads serve every execution's calls in turn); the runtime hands the task's credential to the kernel before each write, and fact_policy (cred=1, files=1) charges the bytes vfs_write accepted for regular files to the writing task's credential (fexit/vfs_write). Reference: what each write returned, per execution. All executions share one PID, and in async mode one thread, so per-process or per-thread counters cannot separate them.
